journey.label: Your next step
test: Choose Saved draft, start the test and perform a game action. Once the current revision has qualifying evidence, review it for publication.
choose: Search or select an item to edit it. Use Create to start something new.
create: Complete the creation form and check the preview, then save. You can refine the details afterwards.
edit: Make your changes here. Nothing reaches players until you save, review and publish.
saved: Continue editing or review the saved changes together. The shared draft is not live yet.
tested: An engine action was accepted for this saved version. Review all saved changes before publishing.
save: Your edits are still in this browser. Finish the required fields, then save them to the shared draft.
blocked: Follow the message above. Your local edits are kept while you resolve the conflict or connection.
fix: Open the highlighted field, correct it and save again.

sections.identity: Edit the name and printed wording. Artwork changes the look; Mechanics changes what the card does.
sections.artwork: Choose a printing or image and check the actual card preview. Save artwork changes before moving to another record.
sections.mechanics: Choose what happens in game, then save and use Test to check the behavior.
sections.test: Choose Live to inspect published behavior, or Saved draft to test saved changes. Start the test and perform a game action; only Saved draft evidence counts toward release.
sections.composition: Choose the cards and printings in this deck, then check its legality before testing.
sections.story: Write what the player sees before and after the encounter. Continue to the setup to define the battle.
sections.setup: Choose the opponent, deck and supported rules. Save before testing this encounter.
sections.related: Open a linked record to change it. When your work is ready, review all saved changes together.

domains.modes: Select a page, then click an outlined heading or section in its preview. Use the inspector to edit it; save before release review.
domains.sets: Name this set, then use Create card in this set. Each new card keeps this set relationship.
domains.campaigns: Write the campaign introduction, then add a chapter encounter. Open a chapter to edit its story and battle setup.
domains.offers: Choose the deck recipe, price and availability. Save, then check the storefront preview before release review.
domains.mechanics: Use the preview to attach this mechanic to a compatible card. Save the card and test it before publishing.
